# Fragment default duration precedence

Owned 16×16 neutral VP9 frames, generated by
`scripts/generate_mp4_zero_default_duration.py` without FFmpeg or network.
Each file contains three identical independently decodable frames. The first
run inherits its duration from tfhd (or trex when absent); the second run has
two explicit one-tick durations. Timescale is 50 ticks/s, trex duration is one.
The init segment states zero duration, as normal fragmented init segments do.

The zero control must preserve DTS/PTS 0,0,1 and durations 0,1,1. A present zero
in tfhd overrides trex rather than requesting fallback. Other controls select
one, two or an absent tfhd default. These are acceptance tests of timeline and
packet preservation, not malformed-input refusal tests.
